source.content: Schema.ChildRelationship rel = null; for (Schema.ChildRelationship candidate : Account.SObjectType.getDescribe().getChildRelationships()) { if (candidate.getRelationshipName() == 'Contacts') { rel = candidate; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, rel); System.assertEquals(rel.getRelationshipName(), rel.relationshipname); System.assertEquals(rel.getField(), rel.field); System.assertEquals(rel.getChildSObject(), rel.childsobject); System.assertEquals(rel.isCascadeDelete(), rel.cascadedelete); System.assertEquals(rel.isRestrictedDelete(), rel.restricteddelete); System.assertEquals(rel.isDeprecatedAndHidden(), rel.deprecatedandhidden); System.assertEquals(rel.getJunctionIdListNames(), rel.junctionidlistnames); System.assertEquals(rel.getJunctionReferenceTo(), rel.junctionreferenceto); System.assert(rel.equals(rel)); System.assertEquals(rel.hashCode(), rel.hashCode()); System.assert(rel.toString().length() > 0);
